behavior_probe.result: workflow.json, owned_paths.json and research-state files were created; no 10_plans offline plan file was created

regression.failure: tests/research-dashboard.test.mjs: dashboard reads JSON-backed yaml state as structured data; actual field was undefined

findings.upstream: Ultragoal writes a repo-native brief.md, goals.json and append-only ledger.jsonl, then prints an explicit handoff for the active Codex goal.
findings.local_gap: The local workflow checkpoint is durable, but a new autopilot plan does not create a compact human-readable offline plan under 10_plans, and the local ultragoal ledger is a mutable per-workflow JSON file.
findings.recommendation: Adopt a project-native plan bundle generated at task start: 10_plans/active/<task-id>/plan.md plus a small machine-readable plan manifest; retain research-state/state.yaml as the only scientific state source.

findings.upstream: Autopilot makes deep-interview -> ralplan -> ultragoal a supervised, ordered, resumable chain and loops back to planning when review or QA disproves the plan.
findings.local_gap: Local autopilot persists deep-interview and consensus-plan handoffs, but its execution FSM runs the research workflow directly and does not require an ultragoal checkpoint before execution/validation.
findings.recommendation: Add the offline-plan/goal checkpoint as a thin gate around the existing FSM; do not replace research-state, contracts, model snapshots, ultraqa, or three-end delivery gates.

findings.upstream: One stable aggregate Codex objective covers the whole run while repo-native stories are checkpointed; shell code does not pretend to mutate hidden /goal state.
findings.local_gap: Local project goals are workflow-local and do not record a stable native-goal handoff or an explicit boundary between project evidence and the active Codex goal.
findings.recommendation: If native goal mode is enabled later, use one aggregate objective per task and store fresh get_goal evidence with each checkpoint. Keep native get_goal/create_goal/update_goal operations in the agent/tool layer; do not invoke hidden goal-clear routes from Node.

findings.upstream: Goal decomposition changes require structured, evidence-backed directives with idempotency; repeated external blockers become a user-decision state instead of an infinite retry loop.
findings.local_gap: The local workflow has idempotent stage events and retryable/blocked states, but no goal-level structured steering ledger.
findings.recommendation: Reuse the idea for future plan revisions only after the P1 plan bundle works; preserve immutable task scope and require evidence for any added/split/reordered step.

findings.upstream: Final goal completion requires fresh verification and, in strict mode, cleaner/review/architecture-invariant evidence; completion is not inferred from the ledger alone.
findings.local_gap: Local ultraqa, report hashes, archive verification and close request already provide stronger project-specific gates, but ultragoal completion is not yet bound to them.
findings.recommendation: Bind any future goal completion to existing ultraqa/report/archive evidence; do not copy the upstream cleaner or review stack as a second QA system.

findings.upstream: The repository ships a global CLI, hooks, tmux/HUD and native runtime components.
findings.local_gap: muIon-beam already has a Windows project supervisor, farmer, dashboard, worktree isolation and delivery policy.
findings.recommendation: Do not clone/install the upstream runtime. The upstream README says native Windows and Codex App are not the default supported path; package.json also has a global postinstall hook that may hydrate a native runtime and write an install stamp.

recommended_now: Keep the pinned checkout and this study record.
Adopt only the plan/goal design as a minimal local Node adapter after explicit scope approval.
Generate the first offline plan before any task-owned write and link it from workflow.json.
Use append-only checkpoint evidence and finite retry/blocked states.
Keep research-state/state.yaml, contracts, manifests, ultraqa and three-end sync authoritative for their existing domains.
not_recommended_now: Copying the TypeScript CLI or hidden Codex goal implementation
Automatic native goal creation without an explicit host/tool authorization boundary
A second writable scientific state source under .omx or a new root-level state file

decision.recommended_scope: minimal-local-adapter: offline plan bundle + aggregate-goal handoff + append-only checkpoint evidence
decision.rationale: The design is useful and maps to an observed local gap, but evolution requires the user to choose the durable file scope; the upstream runtime is unnecessary and less supported on this Windows Codex Desktop host.
